nodes.label: Logo Universidad del Cauca (Logo_Unicauca2.png)
nodes.description: Official institutional logo/crest of the Universidad del Cauca (University of Cauca, Colombia). Features a heraldic shield with a hand holding a torch/flame at center, ornate scroll-work surround, a banner with Latin motto 'POST TENEBRAS LUX MORITURI', founding year '1827' inscribed at the bottom, and 'UNIVERSIDAD DEL CAUCA' text. Rendered in grayscale/black-and-white line art style. Used as a branding asset in the DeporteParaTodos frontend application.
nodes.purpose: Institutional branding — university identity logo displayed in the application UI

Latin motto banner: POST TENEBRAS LUX MORITURI
